_meta.description: 13-weeks rolling cashflow forecast for ZZP'ers and small MKB (REQ-CF-000..017). Declarative per ADR-031; merged additively per ADR-037. Field naming normalised to the app-wide administrationId convention (the spec's administrazioneId/amministrazioneId variants are typos).

CashflowForecastHorizon.title: Cashflow Forecast Horizon
CashflowForecastHorizon.description: The 13-week rolling cashflow window for one administration (REQ-CF-000/001). Rolls forward every Monday 02:00 UTC: week-1 is archived, week-13 is appended. Categorisation follows IAS 7 / RJ 360 (operationeel / investering / financiering).

enterpriseId.description: Denormalised reference to the onderneming/corporation this horizon belongs to (REQ-CF-001).
enterpriseId.title: Onderneming ID

horizonStart.description: First day of the 13-week window (a Monday) (REQ-CF-001).
horizonStart.title: Horizon Start

horizonEnd.description: Last day of the window (Sunday, +90 days) (REQ-CF-001).
horizonEnd.title: Horizon Eind

rolledOn.description: Timestamp of the last weekly roll (REQ-CF-001).
rolledOn.title: Rolled Op

openingBalance.description: Opening balance breakdown across the operational account and the three spaardoel buckets (REQ-CF-001/014).

businessAccount.description: Operational business account balance in EUR.
businessAccount.title: Zakelijke Rekening

savings_goal_vat.description: BTW reserve bucket in EUR (trust money owed to the Belastingdienst).
savings_goal_vat.title: Spaardoel BTW

savings_goal_buffer.description: Emergency buffer bucket in EUR (1-3 months fixed costs).
savings_goal_buffer.title: Spaardoel Buffer

total.description: Sum of all four balances in EUR.
total.title: Totaal

openingBalance.title: Opening Saldo

crisisModeActive.description: True when a negative saldo is predicted within the next 4 weeks; triggers daily recompute (REQ-CF-010).
crisisModeActive.title: Crisis Mode Actief

active.label: Active
active.description: Current live horizon. Aggregations compute the 13 weeks against it.

rolling.label: Rolling
rolling.description: Transient state held while the Monday roll archives week-1 and appends week-13. Idempotent: re-running the same Monday's roll does not duplicate.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Superseded by a newer horizon. Remains queryable for audit; excluded from default listings.

countByLifecycleState.description: Number of horizons per lifecycle state.

CashflowWeek.title: Cashflow Week
CashflowWeek.description: One weekly slot in the 13-week horizon with inflows/outflows by category and computed ending saldo (REQ-CF-002). nettoMutatie = inflows_totaal - outflows_totaal; eindSaldo = openingSaldo + nettoMutatie.

weekId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the week slot (REQ-CF-002).
weekId.title: Week ID

openingBalance.description: Opening balance for the week (previous week's eindSaldo or horizon opening) (REQ-CF-002).
openingBalance.title: Opening Saldo

inflows_ar_gerealiseerd.description: Actual AR receipts from bankfeed, filled post-settlement (REQ-CF-002/012).
inflows_ar_gerealiseerd.title: Inflows AR Gerealiseerd

inflows_total.description: Sum of all inflows for the week (REQ-CF-002).
inflows_total.title: Inflows Totaal

outflows_recurring_dga_pay.description: DGA salary withdrawal for the week (REQ-CF-002/005).
outflows_recurring_dga_pay.title: Outflows Recurring Dga Loon

outflows_vat_remittance.description: Quarterly BTW settlement, if due this week (REQ-CF-002/007).
outflows_vat_remittance.title: Outflows BTW Afdracht

outflows_ib_assessment.description: Annual IB/VPB settlement, if due this week (REQ-CF-002/008).
outflows_ib_assessment.title: Outflows Ib Aanslag

outflows_total.description: Sum of all outflows for the week (REQ-CF-002).
outflows_total.title: Outflows Totaal

bufferStatus.description: Buffer status per the active buffer policy (REQ-CF-002/009).
bufferStatus.title: Buffer Status

alerts.description: Alert records raised for this week (REQ-CF-009/010).
alerts.title: Alerts

inflowsArByWeek.description: Projected AR inflows summed per week (REQ-CF-002 weekly aggregation). Feeds the bar chart inflows series.

outflowsByWeek.description: Total outflows summed per week (REQ-CF-006/007). Feeds the bar chart outflows series.

countByBufferStatus.description: Number of weeks per buffer status, for alert badges (REQ-CF-009).

CashflowARProjection.title: Cashflow AR Projection
CashflowARProjection.description: One record per open AR invoice projecting the expected receipt date from customer-specific betalingsgedrag history rather than the contractual due date (REQ-CF-003/004).

arInvoiceId.description: FK to the AR invoice (read-only; from bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core) (REQ-CF-004).
arInvoiceId.title: AR Invoice ID

expectedReceiptDate.description: Projected receipt date = vervalDatum + mean betalingsgedrag offset (REQ-CF-003/004).
expectedReceiptDate.title: Verwacht Ontvangst Datum

expectedReceiptWeek.description: ISO week string of the projected receipt (REQ-CF-004).
expectedReceiptWeek.title: Verwacht Ontvangst Week

payment_history_average_deviation.description: Mean offset from due date as a signed-days string (REQ-CF-004).
payment_history_average_deviation.title: Betalingshistorie Gemiddeldeafwijking

payment_history_invoices12m.description: Count of settled invoices in the 12-month sample (REQ-CF-003/004).
payment_history_invoices12m.title: Betalingshistorie Facturen12Mnd

payment_history_paid_for_expiry.description: Count of invoices paid on or before the due date (REQ-CF-004).
payment_history_paid_for_expiry.title: Betalingshistorie Betaaldvoorverval

reliabilityScore.description: Confidence score = min(1.0, count/12); below 5 samples this is marked LAAG (REQ-CF-003/004).
reliabilityScore.title: Betrouwbaarheid Score

projectedReceiptsByWeek.description: Sum of outstanding AR amounts grouped by projected receipt week (REQ-CF-002/003). This is the source aggregation for CashflowWeek.inflows_ar_geprognosticeerd.

CashflowAPSchedule.title: Cashflow AP Schedule
CashflowAPSchedule.description: One record per scheduled AP outflow within the horizon, derived from open AP invoices' due dates (REQ-CF-006).

apTransactionId.description: FK to the AP invoice/transaction (read-only; from bookkeeping-accounts-payable-core) (REQ-CF-006).
apTransactionId.title: AP Transaction ID

scheduledPaymentsByCategory.description: Sum of scheduled AP outflows grouped by category (REQ-CF-006). Feeds CashflowWeek.outflows_ap_geprognosticeerd.

CashflowRecurring.title: Cashflow Recurring Cost
CashflowRecurring.description: A declarative recurring inflow/outflow stream (huur, verzekering, abonnementen, DGA-loon, lijfrentepremie, leasing) auto-expanded into the 13-week horizon by frequency, activation window and optional CPI indexing (REQ-CF-005). The CashflowRecurringGuard validates the definition on save (ADR-031 exception).

dagFromMonth.description: Day of month for monthly recurrence; null for other frequencies (REQ-CF-005).
dagFromMonth.title: Dag Van Maand

monthOfYear.description: Month for annual recurrence; null for other frequencies (REQ-CF-005).
monthOfYear.title: Maand Van Jaar

indexationRule.description: Indexation rule: fixed amount or annual CBS-CPI update (REQ-CF-005).
indexationRule.title: Indexatie Regel

validFrom.description: Effective start date; weeks before this are ignored (REQ-CF-005).
validFrom.title: Geldig Van

validTo.description: Expiration date; null if indefinite; weeks after this are ignored (REQ-CF-005).
validTo.title: Geldig Tot

accountNumberExpense.description: GL account code (FK to Account.accountNumber) used on settlement (REQ-CF-005).
accountNumberExpense.title: Account Number Expense

contractReference.description: FK to Contract (contract-lifecycle-management); null means this recurring cost has no originating contract — a dated planned cost (budget-known-costs REQ-BKC-001). Additive, optional field.
contractReference.title: Contract Reference

cpiRatePercent.description: Operator-supplied annual indexation rate (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%), consumed when indexationRule = CPI_PAST_YEAR; null means the rate is not yet known and CPI_PAST_YEAR indexation cannot be computed until it is supplied (budget-known-costs REQ-BKC-003). Additive, optional field.
cpiRatePercent.title: CPI Rate Percent

countByCategorie.description: Number of recurring items per category (REQ-CF-005).

CashflowBufferPolicy.title: Cashflow Buffer Policy
CashflowBufferPolicy.description: Operator-configured minimum cash reserve with two-tier alerts: vooralarm at 150% (yellow) and ondergrens at 50% (red) of the calculated buffer (REQ-CF-009).

countByPolicy.description: Number of buffer policies per policy type (REQ-CF-009).

CashflowScenario.title: Cashflow Scenario
CashflowScenario.description: An immutable what-if snapshot of a horizon with one or more adjustments, re-computed for comparison against the baseline (REQ-CF-011). Scenarios are data, not stored logic (ADR-031).

description.example: Stress test: largest debtor defaults this quarter.
description.title: Description

aanpassingen.description: Array of adjustment rules (AR_PROJECTION_OVERRIDE, RECURRING_COST_ADJUSTMENT, NEW_REVENUE, BUFFER_POLICY_OVERRIDE) (REQ-CF-011).

weekShift.description: Number of weeks to shift the receipt for AR_PROJECTION_OVERRIDE.
weekShift.title: Week Shift

expectedReceiptWeek.description: Expected receipt week number for NEW_REVENUE.
expectedReceiptWeek.title: Expected Receipt Week

aanpassingen.title: Aanpassingen

result.description: Computed forecast results, populated after recalculation (REQ-CF-011).

minBufferWeek.description: ISO week of the minimum saldo.
minBufferWeek.title: Min Buffer Week

minBufferAmount.description: Minimum saldo across the horizon in EUR.
minBufferAmount.title: Min Buffer Bedrag

onderschrijdingBuffer.description: True if any week breaches the buffer ondergrens.
onderschrijdingBuffer.title: Onderschrijding Buffer

actiesuggesties.description: Ranked action suggestions for this scenario.
actiesuggesties.title: Actiesuggesties

result.title: Resultaat

CashflowCalibrationReport.title: Cashflow Calibration Report
CashflowCalibrationReport.description: Post-month-end forecast accuracy report comparing actual vs forecast by category (MAPE), used to recalibrate betalingsgedrag and pipeline-conversion models (REQ-CF-013).

customerId.title: Klant ID
customerId.description: The identifier of the associated klant.

newReliability.title: Nieuwe Betrouwbaarheid
newReliability.description: The numeric value for nieuwe betrouwbaarheid.

oldProbability.title: Oude Kans
oldProbability.description: The numeric value for oude kans.

nieuweKans.title: Nieuwe Kans
nieuweKans.description: The numeric value for nieuwe kans.

avgArMapeByPeriod.description: Average AR MAPE per calibration period, for the accuracy trend (REQ-CF-013).
